email.subject: Redline Pros: a couple quick fixes for Harbor Falls drivers
email.body:
Hi Chloe,

I checked Redline Pros Auto Care's site. Two things are likely costing you booked jobs: your hours aren't listed anywhere, so people searching "auto shop open now" can't tell if you're open and just call a competitor instead. And your homepage images are large enough to slow loading on phones, which is where most local searches happen - slow pages lose visitors before they see your services.

I also noticed the footer has outdated info and the page title doesn't reflect what you do, which hurts how you show up in search.

I fix stuff like this for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough of what I found?

Alex
